scope: Deepen the existing InventorLoader candidate review across DXF/SAT/SAB route composition, geometric degradation, input safety, resource limits, and readiness for optional semantic evidence.

method.kind: Public upstream project source, README, and issue review
method.evidenceBoundary: Mutable upstream source establishes code structures inspected in this pass, not runtime behavior, exploitability, completeness, compatibility, or a semantic support claim. The complete input-to-eval call chain, resource bounds, doc.entities scope, source-handle mapping, and output topology were not executed or fully audited.

observed: The project advertises SAT/SAB import and documents unsupported blending surfaces, helix surfaces, and law-defined curves/surfaces without spline data.
The inspected importer gathers built faces and first attempts Part.Shell(faces). On exception, it logs and emits the faces separately.
The inspected construction path also emits wires/edges; it does not call a Part.Solid constructor in the reviewed body/lump path.
doesNotEstablish: how often the fallback occurs or whether a particular input yields a closed shell
valid closed-solid semantics, complete source-to-output face disposition, or volume preservation
runtime behavior of a pinned FreeCAD/OCCT/add-on build
evidence.planUse: Reject face/wire fallback as semantic success. For any later composed check, inventory source bodies/lumps/shells/faces/edges, emitted FreeCAD shape types, failed constructions, closure, validity, units, transforms, bounds, area, and volume.

evidence.topic: Combined outer DXF and inner ACIS routes
observed: The DXF add-on calls ezdxf.readfile, extracts entity .sab or .sat content, and passes it to InventorLoader's own AcisReader.
Collected payloads receive synthetic basename/index names in the inspected wrapper; no explicit source handle/owner/placement crosswalk was visible in the reviewed path.
This wrapper is not a DWG or AcDs reader; its output shape route uses FreeCAD Part/OCCT.
doesNotEstablish: the complete scope of ezdxf doc.entities or behavior for nested blocks, layouts, and transformed INSERTs
that all source references, owners, payloads, and transforms are retained
independence of the parser implementation lineage without further source audit
evidence.planUse: Use only as an optional exact-hash direct SAT/SAB comparator after separately preserving source handle, type, owner/block path, transform, and payload association. Do not count it as an independent DXF vote, DWG/AcDs route, or independent-kernel result.

observed: The inspected readLaw helper constructs a Law from parsed expression text.
Law.evaluate rewrites the expression's caret operator and calls eval(self.eq) without explicit restricted globals or locals.
doesNotEstablish: the complete call reachability from each supported input profile to Law.evaluate
a reproduced exploit, impact, or current upstream remediation status
bounded CPU, memory, recursion, parser allocation, or geometry-kernel resource use
evidence.planUse: Do not execute the current candidate against downloaded or otherwise untrusted payloads. Before any external evidence run, pin and audit the full call chain, replace expression evaluation with a strict grammar/AST whitelist or otherwise prove a safe reachable contract, and audit size/time/resource limits. Isolated disposable execution may be diagnostic only and cannot qualify safety.

observed: The README advertises an older broad FreeCAD prerequisite while issue #96 reports an API break under FreeCAD 1.0 for an import path.
The reviewed pages are mutable and this pass did not identify or build an immutable add-on artifact.
doesNotEstablish: whether the reported break remains in current source or affects SAT/SAB/DXF imports
compatibility on any native Linux, Windows, or macOS FreeCAD build
evidence.planUse: Pin the exact add-on commit, FreeCAD build, OCCT, ezdxf, and Python environment; preflight compatibility and record NOT_AVAILABLE if the route cannot be reproduced. Do not install it for ordinary local slices.

nextActions: Keep InventorLoader optional and non-blocking; do not add it to the repository build or per-slice test loop.
Do not feed untrusted or downloaded payloads to the inspected unrestricted eval path.
At a future composed check, pin all route components and require complete identity/ownership/transform and shape-disposition manifests.
Reject face/shell/wire fallback, unsupported or missing records, and unclassified loss as a semantic pass.
Keep FreeCAD/OCCT geometry corroboration separate from the required independent-kernel evidence.
